card.name: Scattered mid-name and number positions
card.fires_on: Fires on mixed spots in drug labels: partway through brand or drug names (elagolix, XELJANZ), inside CYP3A4, and on numbers or 'breast' and 'one' before a time span or noun.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of a drug or brand name, such as el-ag-olix or XELJ-AN-Z.

modes.label: Numbers in ranges and durations
modes.description: A number or the word one right before a unit of time or age.
modes.example: in about 2% to 4% of patients treated for<< one>> year.

modes.label: Word before cancer
modes.description: The word breast just before cancer in a history statement.
modes.example: is contraindicated in women with a known or suspected history of<< breast>> cancer.

card.plain: It lights up at scattered points inside drug names, enzyme names and numbers in label text, with no single theme.
